verdict.rationale: Superset's agent-status docs say it notifies you both when an agent finishes and when it pauses for your input. That covers both halves of the story. The workspace list also shows running agents inline. missing for 10: details on notification channels and configuration (desktop/OS, mobile, sound), independent or hands-on corroboration of the notifications working.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get notified when an agent completes a task or needs my input

citations.quote: Finished / waiting for input: get notified when an agent finishes or pauses for your input.
Running agents and open ports appear inline on the workspace item
